sources.snippet: The model's goal is to leverage state-of-the-art Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation primarily sourced from Claude-4.6 Opus interactions. This model introduces higher-quality reasoning trajectories across domains such as science, instruction-following, and mathematics.
